description: This Java source file defines the 'UnknownPathException' class, a custom exception indicating an unrecognized path in a protocol adapter component. It includes metadata, constructors, and a builder for creating instances tied to specific unknown paths, serving as part of error handling within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: UnknownPathException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception for unknown protocol paths. It includes static methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a nested Builder class for constructing instances with customizable properties.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A static nested class providing a fluent API for building UnknownPathException instances. It allows setting message, description, cause, href, and headers, with default descriptions and constructors based on a JsonPointer path.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for UnknownPathException, initialized with a specific JsonPointer path.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an UnknownPathException from a simple message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an UnknownPathException from a JSON object and headers, extracting message details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new UnknownPathException with the specified headers, copying other properties from the current instance.
